claim.quote: The minimum upper limit, $3.7\times10^{-44}$\,cm$^2$, for the spin-independent isoscalar DM-particle-nucleon scattering cross section is obtained at a DM-particle mass of 49\,GeV/c$^2$ at 90\% confidence level.

key_value.note: Minimum upper limit at 49 GeV/c^2, 90% CL.
key_value.quote: $3.7\times10^{-44}$\,cm$^2$, for the spin-independent isoscalar DM-particle-nucleon scattering cross section

name: First dark matter search results from the PandaX-I experiment

published.quote: Xiao M J, Xiao X, Zhao L, et al. First dark matter search results from the PandaX-I experiment. Sci China-Phys Mech Astron, 2014, 57(11): 2024-2030

summary.plain: PandaX-I's first results, after 17 days of data, found no dark matter and cast doubt on earlier claimed low-mass signals.
summary.technical: 37-kg liquid xenon target with 17.4 live days: no DM candidate; stringent limit for low-mass DM; the abstract says it disfavors the interpretation of previously-reported positive experimental results; minimum SI limit 3.7e-44 cm^2 at 49 GeV/c^2 (90% CL).

title: First dark matter search results from the PandaX-I experiment
why_it_matters: First result of the PandaX programme.
